# CabinClarity

> CabinClarity helps cabin and lake-home buyers evaluate a lake before they
> buy — water clarity history, water quality, 303(d) impairment status,
> invasive species, fish and fishing guidance, ice records, access points,
> and nearby recreation — distilled into a plain-language report with a
> composite Shoreline Score.

CabinClarity covers Minnesota, Wisconsin, and Michigan lakes. It presents
public government and volunteer-monitoring data with attribution; it is an
independent product not endorsed by any agency.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cabinclarity.app/): product overview, features, screenshots,
  and why lake data matters before a cabin purchase
- [Data sources & licenses](https://cabinclarity.app/data-sources.html):
  every data source the reports use (MI EGLE/DNR, MiCorps, MN & WI DNR, MPCA,
  MDH, USGS NAS, UMN LakeBrowser, EPA Water Quality Portal, OpenStreetMap)
  with license and attribution terms
- [Privacy policy](https://cabinclarity.app/privacy.html): what data the app
  collects and how it's handled
